Method of Attack: Code injection via command injection in CI scripts due to flawed regex and missing authentication checks
Exploitation of vulnerable CI workflow to obtain reverse shell and GitHub authorization token
Unauthorized association of commit hashes with issues via flawed closedWith command
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Visual Studio Code GitHub repository
Attack Vector: Exploitation of missing authentication in closedWith command in CI script
Injection of malicious commit hash in closing comments
Use of GitHub Actions token with write permission to push commits
Indicators of Compromise: PoC commit pushed to VS Code GitHub repository
Reverse shell obtained via CI script exploit
